# Best noise-cancelling headphones under $100

**Best overall: Soundcore Space One (~$100, about $80 with a code)**
- Best Products ranks it #1 under $100. It has adaptive ANC, a padded headband, rotating cups, an EQ app, and 55 hours of battery (40 hours with ANC on) ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/), [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/soundcore-space-one)).
- Dealectric lists the code AFSC20 for $19.99 off, which brings it to about $80. They tested it in Soundcore's cart on Oct 22, and it expires Dec 31, 2026. Confirm the price at checkout.
- Downsides: it's on the heavy side, has no sweat resistance, and LDAC doesn't work with multipoint.
- [Buy at Soundcore's US store](https://dealectric.com/go/soundcore-space-one). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.

**Strongest noise blocking: Soundcore Space Q45 (~$99)**
- RTINGS found it the best budget ANC headphone they've tested, with excellent engine-rumble and chatter reduction. Some owners report the headband cracking over time ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).
- Battery figures conflict between sources. RTINGS measured about 28 hours, while CartIQ cites 38 to 50 hours.
- I don't have a direct store link, but the RTINGS page has Amazon and Walmart buttons.

**Best value for ANC: Soundcore Life Q30 (under $100)**
- RTINGS' top over-ear pick under $100. ANC is good against engines and chatter, battery is about 44 hours, and the fit is comfortable. It leaks some sound at higher volumes ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/over-ear-headphones-under-100)).
- The Life Q20 (2024) is a cheaper alternative with nearly the same isolation and 49 hours of battery, but its build is creakier ([RTINGS](https://www.rtings.com/headphones/reviews/best/budget-noise-cancelling-headphones)).

**Lightest: Sony WH-CH720N (~$99)**
- It weighs 192 g and has solid ANC against HVAC hum and keyboard noise. It only supports SBC and AAC, with no LDAC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).

**Cheapest: Edifier Atom Max (~$45)**
- It's light and foldable, with 45 hours of battery and ANC up to 44 dB. It has no 3.5mm jack ([Best Products](https://www.bestproducts.com/tech/gadgets/g61501080/cheap-noise-canceling-headphones-under-100/)).
- The 1MORE SonoFlow SE (~$65) is another budget option with a 70-hour battery, but weaker ANC ([CartIQ](https://www.cartiq.net/us/electronics/best-noise-cancelling-headphones-under-100/)).

**My recommendation:** For the best mix of features and comfort, get the Space One, especially at the code price. If noise reduction matters most, choose the Q45. If you want the lowest price, choose the Edifier Atom Max.

Prices change often, so check the retailer before buying.
